reproduction.expected: A compatible Skill can be bound at a declared extension point through a deterministic overlay without rewriting the base Skill or Workflow, and the result compiles through the existing WorkflowSpec and graph validator.
reproduction.actual: Skill contracts expose extension_type and extension_points, but skillctl has no compose command and the Authoring Core performs no graph composition or provenance generation.

violated_invariants: Extension metadata must be operationally useful without granting execution or write authority.
Adding a compatible Skill should create a reviewable overlay rather than rewrite the original Skill or Workflow.
Composed graphs must still terminate at the existing WorkflowSpec and graph validator.
